text_block_list.text:
Now that her challenge for the Triple Tiara has ended,
we must decide on Mejiro Dober's
next goal...

To become a new glory for the Mejiro family.
If I am to conclude my Classic Year, then it truly must be that race...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what are your thoughts on the next race?
choice_data_list: Let's run in the "Arima Kinen", Dober.

text_block_list.text:
With the Senior year approaching, experiencing the frontline's
true caliber firsthand will surely be indispensable
for her upcoming challenges.

"Still, considering the races up until now,
she will likely face a harsh battle, both in terms of distance and the depth of the competition."

"...Even so,
I want to take on our biggest race, the Arima Kinen,
together with Mejiro Dober with everything we've got."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For the upcoming Arima Kinen...
She'll definitely enter, won't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove-senpai did.
Just as she said, the "Empress" Air Groove will undoubtedly run in the upcoming Arima Kinen.
And... it's sure to be the greatest threat Mejiro Dober has ever faced.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...No, really. It's actually the complete opposite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry, that's not it.
I wasn't quiet because I disliked it... Quite the opposite, actually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so happy.
That I finally get to run alongside you, Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We'd better start training for the Arima Kinen now.
Especially stamina-wise, there are lots of things to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's start training early today.
I'm already itching to get going...!

She doesn't seem intimidated at all.
If anything, she's overflowing with motivation...!

With this, we can expect great results.
Starting that very day, training toward the Arima Kinen began...!
One day, at the Mejiro Estate—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, Dober!
This is terrible—!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-What's wrong, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is the Arima Kinen.
Have you already seen the fan voting results~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, didn't that come out today?
I haven't watched it yet, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is this for real!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Among such an illustrious lineup, you came in 3rd place in votes~!
That's amazing, Dober~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Being this popular in your Classic Year is incredible!
You did it, Dober...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please run with your head held high on race day.
We are very much looking forward to it as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna run anyway,
you might as well stir up a total storm out there♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Go engrave Dober's "now" into Nakayama.
I am certain it will become a tale passed down for generations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Everyone... thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to run together with Dober too~.
In the Arima Kinen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's always next year~
When that time comes, Dober and I can simply
run together~.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And with that said~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober.
May you have a race with no regrets."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The one with the most votes is Air Groove-senpai, just as expected...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(At the Arima, I want to run a race to be proud of...
As the "New Glory of Mejiro"...!)
